meta.name: long-context
meta.description: Extend context windows of transformer models using RoPE, YaRN, ALiBi, and position interpolation techniques. Use when processing long documents (32k-128k+ tokens), extending pre-trained models beyond original context limits, or implementing efficient positional encodings. Covers rotary embeddings, attention biases, interpolation methods, and extrapolation strategies for LLMs.

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can extend the context window of transformer models (e.g., LLaMA, Mistral) from original length (e.g., 8k) to 32k–128k+ tokens using RoPE, YaRN, ALiBi, or position interpolation, enabling processing of longer documents or conversations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when processing text exceeding the original context length (e.g., 32k–128k+ tokens), or when extending pre-trained models (like LLaMA, Mistral) for longer context capabilities.
